# Supplemental Requests Tables

This document is just for formatting tables for screenshotting and pasting into the Google Doc 

## Table Example

```{r, tbl-load}
#| include: false
source(here::here("R/table_sens.R"))
selectivity_table <- read.csv(here::here("models/supplemental_requests/Request 4/table.csv"), check.names = FALSE)
```

```{r, tbl-selectivity, results = "asis"}
#| warning: false
#| echo: false
#| eval: true
#| tbl-cap: Table of likelihoods, key parameters, and quantities of interest for the models that explore alternative functional forms for selectivity of the WCGBT Survey.
#| tbl-pos: H

selectivity_table |> table_sens()
```
